package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"io"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_serialization_base64_roundtrip_for_binary_transport: Layer: Serialization and deserialization. Flag base64 encode/decode roundtrips inside a single process boundary.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario589Positive(w io.Writer, payloads [][]byte) error {
	for i, data := range payloads {
		encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data)
		decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(encoded)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("decode payload %d: %w", i, err)
		}
		if _, err := w.Write(decoded); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("write payload %d: %w", i, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
